stem: Why did the economies of western territories develop so differently from the economies of the Northeast and South?

options.label: F
options.text: Western territories had limited land and a large immigrant population.

options.label: G
options.text: Western territories had natural harbors and many navigable rivers.

options.label: H
options.text: Western territories had rocky soil and a large supply of slave labor.

options.label: J
options.text: Western territories had inexpensive land and abundant natural resources.
